mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 50 degrees, with a full moon glowing above the Verona Public Library.

The city has announced that a section of Highway M near the new Aldi will close from October 5 to October 7 for final paving work, so please follow the detours using Old PB and Main Street. Additionally, the planning department reminds residents to be wary of scammers posing as city staff for fee payments.

We have a busy schedule ahead with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Looking ahead, you can join a yoga session tomorrow at Insight Wellness or check out trivia nights starting September 29.
On September 5, Verona officers responded to reports of local vehicles being pranked with cheese slices on their windshields as part of a viral trend, though no property damage was reported.
Stop by for the delightful Turtle flavor of the day, and please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
